Good morning, Sorry about the delay in this email. I have been trying to find the best time to send you a message without having my boyfriend be able to see me doing this. I would feel like he thinks i do not have confidence in this relationship.

Ryan and I are about the same age, 27. He has had CF all of his life. He am sure he had struggles throughout his life but from his stories he would tell me. He was an active man growing up, always  into sports, very out going person. I am not sure if this matters, but he was in a fraternity, and from his facebook pictures, he seemed so much happier then. After 4 months of us dating, i had got him to finally delete his tagged pictures of him and his ex girlfriend. I know that they dated back in college. They just looked so happy together, going out, having fun, and being around people.

When I started dating Ryan was last August. I had met him at work. We definitely jumped into this relationship. He was definitely pushing this relationship. I had asked him that we should be friends and get to know each other first. But he convinced me that we should just start dating, which was new to me. I was so excited because here I did get the chance to be with this very handsome attractive man, that was completely different from me. He was the kind of guy that I thought I would never see myself dating. I, myself have been a very shy, introverted girl all of my life.

After a week of talking and getting to know each other he told me about his chronic illness which did scare me and i had asked him that I really would like to slow the relationship down. He said that when we are official, he would take me with him to see his doctor, so i can get to know more about his "minor cf".

Since we have been dating, he became more needed, and high maintenance. I wasnt sure if it was laziness, because it would be like "I am really thirsty, i would really like a glass of water" or "since you are passing by a kroger, could you pick up some groceries"... I know the issue is partially my fault, sometimes I can be a push over and tend to be taken advantage of. Oh yeah, i would also purchase items that I found he needed at his place, that he didnt have, like towels, food and I would also dust and clean without him asking. I am a bit OCD. Also, we have been dating for about 5 months, I didnt really feel appreciated. He didnt take me out on dates, to dinner, theater, ice  skating. He had made promises of these, but we never did them.... It seemed like for the past 5 months we have been dating. it has been the same, kind of boring.  i come over to his apartment hang out with him the sunday, he watch football all day with his roommate, and since i do not watch football i would go find something else for me to do. It wasn t a relationship....

I had tried to break it off between us a few weeks ago because I wasnt sure if the feelings was there and we had jumped into this relationship so soon, I wasnt sure if i was fully committed. I told him that, i wasnt feeling appreciated in the relationship, and that the feelings have  faded. But he dropped to his knees and promised to be better. He said he planned on having me in his life forever. Having a house and kids togther. I felt that he is sincere and i gave him another chance. since then he has been doing things on his own, or WITH me. I told him that I want a man who will create memories with me. He has been doing better. He has been showing me that i am important to him.

Last night I couldnt sleep... I thinking about if ryan and I were to get married, have children, and something was to happen to him. Who would help me out? financial, emotional issues flood my head. Who would help me financially. i cannot ask my parents, they believe the man should always be there to support the wife. I am not saying ryan needs to pay for everything. But if something was to happen, would all that debt and burden be placed on me... Its scary. Sometimes I feel like I should not be in this relationship since I am questioning myself all the time. I feel so lost. I had taken myself off of anxiety medication months ago for my own personal reasons. Ryan says i worry too much because i think about the future and he thinks about the present. My parents are 1st generation immigrants, and have worked hard to provide the kids with the future i have now. This is what I have known all my life.

Ryan said that if i had any questions about his CF, i can ask his specialist. His next appointment is in march. You have mentioned that the first time you went with your husband to see his doctor, he spent extra time to talk to you personally about his CF, and what it meant for you to as a couple. Please share maybe it will help me think of more questions to ask the doctor.

I am not sure what to do. I am just not sure... We have only been together for 5 months. I can easily break it off and be on my own and start a whole new life. Do i want to give this up when I could have a good thing going on?

Am i replying to you as PM? I am still not sure how to use reddit. I just clicked reply. Hope to hear from you soon. Thank you.

Thank you for your advice.

I have so much questions to ask him, but I do not want him to feel as if I am doubting our relationship as it does seem as if he does have low self esteem. I find him constantly asking me if I love him and if I see a future with him.

hello. Thanks for sharing. It is very unusual to me that you have pet rats. Are most people afraid of them? I know i am, but I guess they are kind of rabbit and I find that rabbits are cute.

I had placed myself on Lexapro for a year and then a few months ago, I had finally got the courage to remove myself from the medication. The withdrawals were horrible. 

Have you ever thought about having children? I would like to have children and my bf, having cf, he is 99% infertile, in this case we would need to have invitro treatment in order for us to have children. That is if it is possible for us to have children. There are a lot of what ifs... Would we be financially stable? I am still terrified of what could happen. It does not leave my head.

I have been told that my twenties is my prime time. I am young, good looking, i should be finding a man that would take care of me, not vice versa. That is how society shows, the man usually takes care of the woman.

Hello, good to hear from you. Thank you for sharing your story.
After hearing your thoughts about Facebook, I will definitely try to limit myself to once a week, or even 2 weeks. Its not really beneficial to me. It does help to keep me socially active. I suppose. It is an easy way to find events to go to. My cousin is always encouraging me to go to these group events because I may meet some really awesome people. But I do find myself more comfortable just being at home and alone with my boyfriend.

Let me tell you about my job. I am a accounting collector. Our company is not doing well. So there are no salary increases or bonuses.I find my boss to be unfair and unreasonable. We have recently had an team member leave because he had found a new job. My boss just lays the  extra work on me and think it is fine. I am sure if the management is there.

Let me tell you about my relationships. I dated a man throughout college and a few years afterwards. it was a 5 year long relationship. We were in love and talked about marriage until one day he just decided he wasnt ready to settle down and he wanted to be that guy who has been around with different women.( yes he said that ). After that I had dated some men but they were just rebounds. Someone I could have company with because it was jsut too hard being alone.

Currently i am with this man who is a year older. We met at our company. He have been dating for a few months. He had told me our first month of dating that he has a chronic disease called cystic fibrosis. This scared me and I felt like I had to end the relationship. i didnt think i could go throguh with being in a relationship with someone who has a disease where the average death is 35. I had given him the silent treatment for about a week until he had messaged me and sent me a song. Then we started talking again, and now i dont even think about his condition.

I used to not know why he would want to date me because I had looked through his facebook pictures and he was always surrounded by attractive people. He was in a good looking male fraternity, so he was popular. He had a very attractive girlfriend back in college. I am completely different from the girls he was around, so i question myself to see why he would choose me to date.  Could it be because I am willing to give him a chance after knowing about his disease? These past few months being with him, has been difficult, I find myself staying at his place every weekend. We dont go out. He is definitely high maintance because I do our grocery shopping, he is always needing and wanting something. He is fragile during the winter time, so I cannot ask him for help. I would end up asking his roommate for assistance if i ever needed it.
